as_of: 2026-09-20, of3t-orchestrator pass 197. CPU only, no device. Arithmetic on of3t-l1's measured ladder; no measurement here is mine.
headline: 640's backward does not nearly fit. It needs ~46 GB against a 34.22 GB card -- 1.36x, a 12.3 GB deficit -- and the 34.215 GB on the record is where it DIED, not what it requires. That matters because the two levers of3t-l1 proposed were sized against the wrong number: spilling the retained block boundaries buys 5.070 GB, which is 41 % of the deficit. It is necessary and it is not sufficient.
the_misreading_this_corrects: of3t-l1 records '640's backward fails at 34.215 GB of a 34.22 GB card', which reads as a near miss -- 5 MB short of a 34.22 GB card. The same row's own diagnosis says otherwise: the run was refused a 13,107,200 B buffer with 10,603,008 B free, INSIDE THE FIRST checkpoint recompute, with 0 of 2531 weights having received a gradient. A peak recorded at the moment of failure is a LOWER BOUND on the requirement, never the requirement. The backward had barely started.

decomposition.method: split the MEASURED 384 backward into the retained boundaries (scaled from K13's 640 figure at N^2, since z is N^2*c_z and dominates s at N*c_s) and everything else, then scale each to 640

quadratic_fit.form: peak = a + b*N^2 on the three completed rungs

the_control_every_estimate_had_to_pass: the run REACHED 34.215 GB at 640 and still failed, so any model predicting less than 34.215 GB there is refuted on the spot. All three predict 45.6-51.4 GB and pass. This is the cheapest possible check on an extrapolation and it is why the bracket is quotable.

spill_the_48_retained_boundaries_to_host.verdict: NECESSARY, NOT SUFFICIENT -- still 7.23 GB over the card

at_640.and_so: the recompute/tape term must ALSO fall by about 17 % on top of the spill. The two levers of3t-l1 named -- spill the boundaries, recompute a block in halves -- have to be taken TOGETHER at 640. Either alone leaves the card short.

at_768.verdict: a DIFFERENT problem, not a bigger one. At 640 the boundary spill is 41 % of the answer; at 768 it is 22 %, and the remaining term has to be more than halved. A third lever is needed and none has been named.

what_this_does_NOT_establish: that the recompute/tape term can fall 17 %. This file sizes the deficit and prices one lever against it; it does not price the other, because nothing on the record splits the 41.45 GB into recompute versus tape. THAT is the measurement worth taking next, and it can be taken at 384 where the backward completes -- no 640 run is needed to size a 640 lever. The N^2 scaling of the non-boundary term is also an assumption: it is supported by three estimates agreeing and by the observational floor, and it is contradicted at small N, where the 128->256 rung reads exponent 1.550 and the quadratic fit is 15 % high at 128. The pair track dominates at large N, which is the argument for N^2 there -- an argument, not a measurement.
provenance: of3t-orchestrator pass 197 on pc, CPU only, no device opened. Every measured byte is of3t-l1's, read from its committed artifacts. The decomposition, the two fits, the floor control and the lever pricing are this pass's.
